---
title: "G04: Urologicals"
description: "ATC G04 urologicals for modelers: urological endpoints are not continuous; placebo response is large and time-varying."
date: "2026-02-08"
---

Part of [G: Genito-urinary system and sex hormones](../).

**Urological endpoints are not continuous.**
Symptom scores, voiding diaries and incontinence counts are ordered categorical or count data; fitting E~max~ to a group mean discards most of the information [@lyauk2021boundedinteger; @lyauk2020irtipss].

**Placebo response is large and time-varying.**
In benign prostatic hyperplasia the placebo effect on symptom score has been several times the tamsulosin effect [@dagate2020ipss], so model its time course rather than treating it as a fixed offset [@mostafaei2022placebo].
